name: WeightSplitter
description: Splitter. Divides a branch's output among its children by weights; the rounding remainder goes to the largest weight. The weights change through setWeights, which needs SET_SETTINGS_PERMISSION_ID.

inputs.name: dao
inputs.description: The installing DAO. In a recipe: DAO_REF.

inputs.name: weights
inputs.description: One per child of the branch, in the node's child order, each non-zero, summing to 1,000,000.
